title: BikeZ-ETH - A Mass-Cycling Trajectory Dataset from a Controlled Experiment
endpoint_quality: Author-extracted cyclist speed one second ahead

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

calibration_burden: Source computer-vision/Kalman trajectories, 25 Hz; select every 25th frame and exact +/-25-frame pairs. Parts of the same original video remain together. Track IDs may be ambiguous; all 28 riders recur across videos. Source preprocessing may use future smoothing, so predictions are retrospective trajectory dynamics and not certified online safety. Angular-neighbor interaction is a testable approximation; lateral separation and direction reversal are falsifiers.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.intended_target: Author-extracted cyclist speed one second ahead
practical_relevance.prediction_time: Only current and past extracted speeds and current geometry/neighbor state. Future target speed is inaccessible to candidate replay.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Publisher trajectories may have future-dependent smoothing; supplemental rights unresolved.

case_specific_next_evidence:
Collect independent sessions/riders and genuinely causal raw/manual tracking with explicit frame timing and annotation latency.

Repeat matched reverse-direction, shuffled-neighbor and persistence controls on new groups before physical car-following interpretation.

Use signed target validation and actual duration everywhere; no automatic nonnegative filtering of projected motion.
